value.rationale: The full-dihedral six-point symmetry quotient is a canonical natural topological object and a sharp contrast with the previously determined cyclic quotient whose degree-two group contains (Z/3)^2; adding reflections eliminates all torsion and leaves a pure 12-sphere wedge. This nontrivial homotopy-type transition is not inferable from Euler characteristic or rational invariants alone.
